descriptions.text: Remember when you were extra naughty, and your daddy told you to go fetch his belt? This is kind of like that, but a lot more gross. Combination of a mystic Necro card and a Walking Stick totem, it's the Worm Fulcrum! Sentient Necro Staff. Level 50.

beats.headline: The Worm Fulcrum
beats.text: In the turkey barn, to the riff of a Muse song, a small tree rises out of the floor: gnarled roots and leaves, feathers and turkey claws, a black human heart beating on a branch, and on top the golden skull of a large lizard with gems for eyes. The ogre deckmaster Sharp Elbows tosses her walking staff aside and yanks the tree out of the ground, spewing earthworms. The AI announces a Necro card combined with a Walking Stick totem. Donut protests that it is both a totem and a mystic card. Purple light spreads, and the dead turkeys rise.

beats.headline: Snapped by a crab
beats.text: Carl kicks the turkey deckmaster to pieces, and the barn starts to slide toward the cliff. The ogre, still clutching her staff, slams into him like a truck and holds on, her spikes in him, her face against his. Then a loud crack of wood, and the music stops: Raul the crab has snapped the necro staff in half, killing her last totem. He decapitates the ogre next.

beats.headline: In Donut's deck
beats.text: While Carl was out, Donut grabbed every card left floating at the edge of the fight, and Sharp Elbows had a lot. The magical staff card is in their deck now. It is a special card but not consumable; it takes no totem slot, though it holds a card slot while active. She must imbue it with one of her spells before a fight, and can then cast that spell once. The staff works like a totem and looks different depending on the spell. She has already set it up and tried it on Geraldo, and they all started fighting each other until she yelled at them.

beats.headline: Brass, and snatched
beats.text: Against the Reminiscence Hydra, Donut throws her new staff totem. It plants itself beside her with a thrum, brass now with a little cog spinning on top, imbued with Clockwork Triplicate, its card still floating in her hand. At once Judge Lucian throws a snare onto it, and the whole staff reappears next to the hydra. Snatched. Lucian uses it, and three Monobrow Sam heads turn their death ray on Shi Maria together. Dying, she snaps the staff with her legs.

beats.headline: The Hole spell, out of reach
beats.text: Donut has loaded the Hole spell into her staff totem, in the hope of cutting an enemy totem or deckmaster in half. Now, in a collapsing building with Imani and Tran trapped and demons coming up from both sides, a hole is exactly what they need, and the staff is not in her hand. Carl tells her to discard or play everything she can until she gets it.
